text: Occasional LLM pass that proposes missing contributes-to links for human review
description: Felix 2026-11-08: keep linking explicit at creation, and occasionally run an LLM to find links that were not obvious. On demand (MCP tool or prompt), not in the creation path: for floating ideas and ideas with weak parents, take the top embedding candidates (suggestParents) and let an LLM judge 'does A contribute to B, and why' with a one-line hypothesis. Output is a list of proposed links for the human to accept or reject; never auto-applied. Answers the 'missing connections' part of 1e2a1220 without automatic merges. Note cancelled c968f026: an LLM scorer must earn its cost; measure acceptance rate of proposals.
